notes: Annotation depth: CORE — 12 core services + plan-level + appeals_contact. Long tail of services NOT annotated. Full-depth Blue Shield bundled-PDF stress test lives in blue-shield-ca-2025-silver-70-ppo.

Bundled PDF: 194 total pages. SBC content occupies pages 1-8; page 9 begins the bundled Evidence of Coverage (EOC) for 'Small Group Plan, Blue Shield Access+ Silver 70 HMO 2500/55 PCP + Child Dental, Provider Network: Access+'.
Parser gap (not fixed in this PR): Insurer regex array in sbc-parser.ts has /blue\s*cross/ but NO /blue\s*shield/. Parser would emit insurer_name: null. Same gap as the 2 Blue Shield PPO fixtures.

TRUE HMO MODEL: referral_required is TRUE (HMO; cannot self-refer to specialists generally). Out-of-network is mostly NOT COVERED (no out-of-network deductible, no out-of-network OOP). Self-referral allowed for Access+ Specialist visits per the SBC specialist row. Urgent care OON is bifurcated by service area (Within = Not Covered; Outside = $55/visit waived).
Plan year 2026 (most current — newest of all 7 fixtures). Coverage period uses 'Beginning On or After 1/1/2026' single-date format — relies on parser fix #2.
Same-insurer year-shift fixture: Blue Shield 2025 PPO (Bronze + Silver) vs Blue Shield 2026 HMO Silver. Useful for parser plan-year handling and same-insurer-different-product detection.
Coverage tier: 'Individual + Family' — parser maps to 'individual_family'.
Plan name: 'Blue Shield Access+ Silver 70 HMO 2500/55 PCP + Child Dental'. 'Access+' is Blue Shield's branded HMO product; allows self-referral to certain Access+ specialists.

Notable: Infertility Treatment is in Other Covered Services on this HMO (NOT excluded, unlike Blue Shield PPO plans and Ambetter individual plans where infertility is excluded). Captured via different excluded_services_list (omits infertility).
Notable: Imaging copays are flat $300/visit, not coinsurance — different from the PPO Silver 70 (35% coinsurance) and from Bronze 60 PPO (40% coinsurance). HMO uses fixed-dollar imaging copays.
Subject to per-day OON benefit maximums similar to PPO plans, but most OON is just 'Not Covered' on this HMO.
excluded_services_list: non-emergency care when traveling outside the U.S.
